_source: Built from the facts of CBP ruling N353086 (2025-09-25, dev split): CBP held Vietnam. Product written by the agent from the facts, no model draft (D782). Target China (reverse probe: away from a non-China origin); plant capabilities for China and all costs are assumptions. No later ruling on a changed setup, so there is no backtest.

product.name: Portable lithium-ion jump starter, 12,000 mAh
product.description: A lithium-ion battery pack in a plastic case with 12 V, USB-A and USB-C outputs, a work light, an LCD and wireless charging, packed with booster clamps and a power supply.

components.name: Lower plastic case and plastic cover
Main and lamp printed circuit board assemblies
Wireless charging coil and power supply
LCD display, LED backlight and alligator booster clamps

operations.name: Fit the battery pack and main PCBA in the lower case and connect them
Fit the lamp board, wireless coil and LCD board in the cover and connect them
Close, test and pack with the power supply, carry case and clamps
